title: Chapter 599 - 599 Thunder Calamity; Descent!

Chapter 599 - 599 Thunder Calamity; Descent!

Chapter 599 - 599 Thunder Calamity; Descent!

599 Thunder Calamity; Descent!

Sam looked at the Heavenly Hound curiously.

He naturally could not understand what the Heavenly Hound was saying.

However, Lin Fan understood everything.

“There’s the smell of blood!”

The Heavenly Hound would not have cared if it smelled like blood.

After all, the wilderness of the Otherworld was filled with slaughter all the time.

The smell of blood here was probably very strong.

This was the Heavenly Hound’s warning. There might be danger inside!

Danger?

Lin Fan did not care at all.

There was even a hint of anticipation.

This meant that there might be powerful monsters inside.

Killing monsters would allow him to gain strength and even skills.

Hence, Lin Fan continued walking forward at a steady pace.

Very soon…

He was about to enter the mangroves.

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Xiao Bing said nervously, “Professor Lin, be careful!”

Spicy Rabbit Head: [God Lin, don’t go in.]

Bin Bin: [God Lin, it’s dangerous!]

Dejected: [Be careful!]

…

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Qin Yuxuan, and the others clenched their hands tightly, and their pretty faces became even more nervous.

…

Finally, Lin Fan, Sam, and the Heavenly Hound slowly walked into the mangroves under the watchful eyes of countless people.

The ground of the mangroves was very soft. Walking on it was like stepping on a spring cushion.

“This path is so comfortable,” Sam said happily.

Lin Fan frowned.

When he walked into the mangroves, the power in his body seemed to be absorbed by something and was constantly flowing away.

Of course, the speed was very slow.

However, Lin Fan had an extremely strong recovery ability, hence the draining effect was canceled out.

At the same time, he noticed that a dense cluster of red trees had suddenly appeared behind him.

One had to know…

Lin Fan had just walked in. How could there be so many red trees behind him?

Lin Fan muttered in his heart, “This seems interesting.”

Thus, he continued walking forward.

In the beginning, Sam would praise the place from time to time, thinking that it was very beautiful. He was very excited.

However, slowly, Sam became like a patient with a high fever. He became very dispirited and swayed, and he was about to fall to the ground at any time.

When a rock appeared in front of him, Sam fell to the ground and could not get up.

Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound stopped in their tracks.

It was also at this moment that a red three-eyed human-faced monster slowly emerged from behind a red tree.

No!

It was not just one!

Following that, red monsters with three eyes appeared on the left, right, and front.

The four monsters formed a rectangular shape and surrounded Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam.

Their eyes were filled with scarlet light, and they were extremely terrifying.

The next moment, the four monsters opened their mouths and stretched out their claws that were as sharp as steel blades. They charged toward Lin Fan, the Heavenly Hound, and Sam.

Lin Fan did not move at all, but the Heavenly Hound charged forward.

With a few soft sounds, the four monsters were all broken at the waist, and blood splattered everywhere.

Then, Lin Fan continued walking forward.

The Heavenly Hound held Sam, who had fainted, in its mouth and followed behind.

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

“It seems like these monsters can’t harm Professor Lin.”

Red: [Even God Lin doesn’t need to do anything. The Heavenly Hound can deal with them.

Man in the Wind: [Invincible God Lin!]

Commentator: [They’re just monsters. There’s no need for God Lin to take action! He’s that invincible!]

…

Lin Fan kept moving forward. Every time he walked, a few monsters would appear.

However, they were all killed by the Heavenly Hound easily and did not pose any obstruction to Lin Fan.

About an hour later, the mangroves became denser and denser. The entire world seemed to be completely enveloped in scarlet.

Ghastly and terrifying!

At this moment, a tall mountain suddenly appeared in front of them.

There were many caves around the mountain.

A large number of red monsters gathered in front of the cave.

In front of these monsters were people of all ethnicities.

They… They were all heroes chosen by the various countries.

These heroes had either been cut open or their heads were shattered. They were unrecognizable… All of them had lost all signs of life, and fresh blood flowed freely. It was extremely miserable.

Among the red monsters, there were some who hugged the heroes’ thigh and gnawed on them, some who used their sharp claws to reach into their stomachs to eat their internal organs, and some who grabbed the brain and stuffed it into their mouths…

The air was filled with the nauseating smell of blood.

The entire scene was extremely terrifying!

Lin Fan’s originally calm face turned cold instantly.

A ball of raging anger burned wildly.

Even though none of them were Hua people, and it was even possible that some of these heroes were from hostile countries…

However, they were all humans!

A red monster was just about to eat the thigh of the hero in front of it when it was slapped to the side by another red monster.

The red monster seemed to be a little dazed from the beating and shook its head.

It suddenly realized that there was a tall and handsome figure, a dog, and an unconscious man not far away.

Instantly, the monster’s eyes turned red. It opened its mouth and drooled.

It was as if… it could already see the beautiful scene of it eating flesh and blood.

The red monster’s actions quickly attracted the attention of the other monsters. They raised their heads one after another.
